opennyai_summary.arguments:
There is no specific allegation at all either in the FIR or in the statement given by the prosecution witnesses against the present applicants.
He further submits that impugned proceedings are nothing but an abuse of the process of the law.
He has relied on the judgment of the Supreme Court in the case of Kakhashan Kauser @ Sonam & Anr vs State of Bihar & Anr : 2022 (6) SCC 599 (para 7).
opennyai_summary.decision:
Learned A.G.A. opposes the application.
Prima facie the matter requires consideration.
Issue notice to opposite party No.2.
Four weeks' time is granted to the respondents to file counter affidavit.
Two weeks' time thereafter shall be available to the applicants to file rejoinder affidavit.
Till the next date of listing of the case proceedings of Criminal Case No.4378 of 2023 shall remain stayed, so far as it relate to the applicants.
